messages:
Ethan (People Ops): hey team — Sasha starts next Monday. putting a small, actionable first-week checklist here. can folks quickly flag missing items or owners? :wave:

Maya (IT): looks good overall. add: 'company laptop imaged and enrolled in MDM' and 'VPN cert pushed'. i'll own imaging. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Hiring Manager): pls add "first 1:1 with manager on day 1" and a brief role expectations doc. i can draft the 30/60/90 and share by EOD Fri.

Jordan (Engineering): want repo access + dev cluster creds on day 1. tag infra for cluster-access. also add a short "local dev setup" session with an eng buddy. :shipit:

Ethan (People Ops): here's the minimal checklist i'm compiling:
- Slack invite + #team channel ✓
- Email + SSO provisioning ✓
- Laptop imaged & MDM enrolled (Maya)
- VPN / VPC access (Maya/InfraOps)
- GitHub org invite + team perms (Jordan)
- Dev env walkthrough + mentor pairing (Jordan)
- Manager 1:1 day 1 (Priya)
- HR paperwork & benefits orientation (HR Bot)
- Security training & MFA set up
- First-week goals & 30/60/90 draft (Priya)

Maya (IT): small note — we're seeing intermittent SSO token failures when accounts are created too early. if provisioning >48h before start, use this one-off fix: `auth-admin refresh-token --user sasha@example.com`

InfraOps: ping — can you pre-create the dev namespace for sasha and add to the 'platform-developers' group?

InfraOps: done — namespace `sasha-dev` created, added to platform-developers. left a comment in the infra ticket #8893.

Priya (Hiring Manager): thanks — i'll schedule the 30/60/90 walkthrough on Tue @10am and send calendar invites. also i'll attach a 1-paragraph role expectations doc to the invite.

Ethan (People Ops): quick question — who should handle parking temporary cloud credits for onboarding experiments?

Jordan (Engineering): i can allocate a small sandbox budget under my team for the first month. i'll post the billing alias and instructions in the thread.

Jordan (Engineering): billing alias: eng-onboard-sandbox. to request credits: open ticket to billing with subject "sandbox credits: sasha". cc me.

Maya (IT): laptop imaging ETA: image + basic provisioning by Friday COB if asset pick-up arranged. if we need remote ship, add 1 business day.

Ethan (People Ops): great. final ask — can folks react with :thumbsup: when you confirm your owner tasks? i'll assemble and post a tidy checklist doc in Notion and drop the link here.

Priya (Hiring Manager): 👍

Maya (IT): 👍

Jordan (Engineering): 👍

HR Bot: onboarding invite (benefits + policies) sent to sasha@example.com. enrollment link expires in 7 days.

Ethan (People Ops): thanks all — i'll publish the Notion checklist and close the loop. cc @Sasha once published so they can self-check progress on day 0. :tada:
